claims.statement: For fixed positive beta<=1<gamma, beta*gamma>1 and 0<lambda<(gamma/beta)^(sqrt(beta*gamma)/(sqrt(beta*gamma)-1)), every finite simple n>=2 graph with finite positive lambda_v<lambda, beta_e<=beta, gamma_e>=gamma and 1<beta_e*gamma_e<=beta*gamma has uniformly random-site heatbath mixing time O_{beta,gamma,lambda}(n log^2(2n) log(1/epsilon)), 0<epsilon<=1/2, from every initial state.
claims.finite_verifier_scope: Selected finite identities only; not the universal theorem.
limitations: Individual updates, not sweeps or arithmetic work
No uniform ordinary LSI for untrimmed law

claims.statement: Under arbitrary mixed pinning and scalar occupied-zero multiplier 0<s<=1, Cov(X)<= (1+A*s) Diag(E X), with A depending only on the fixed envelope.
claims.evidence_type: written small-field proof plus imported influence/computation-tree results
dependencies: Feng–Guo–Yang v2 Theorem 24, Proposition 14, Lemmas 27/29 and equation (15)
claims.finite_verifier_scope: Pinning/tilt algebra only; no full covariance certificate.

claims.statement: Deterministic high-degree/high-bias sites have uniformly small zero probabilities after two coupon-collector windows; retained conditional marginals are polynomially bounded and retained dynamics use the original site clock.
claims.finite_verifier_scope: Exact selected retained-clock and conditional-law identities; not uniform rare-event bound.

claims.statement: For full-support finite product-space heatbath dynamics and deterministic pinning F, d_P(b+t)<=d_Q(t)+sup_z P_z(exists j=0..t: X_{b+j} notin F)+mu(F^c), with Q retaining the original site clock.
limitations: Not claimed as a new general theorem

claims.statement: The original chain has inverse gap <=n(1+kappa)e^A, kappa=max(1,lambda), including mixed-pinned residual systems. Fixed positive nonuniform selection gives inverse gap <=(1+kappa)e^A/min_v p_v.
claims.evidence_type: imported gap consequence and elementary Dirichlet comparison
limitations: Nonuniform conclusion is relaxation, not worst-start mixing
